mutations.name: the bridge forwards every key the story sees
kills: the story bridge forwards only [, ], Escape and ? from the story, never Enter, a digit, a letter or a held modifier

mutations.name: the bridge forwards a key held with Cmd or Ctrl
kills: the story bridge forwards only [, ], Escape and ? from the story, never Enter, a digit, a letter or a held modifier

mutations.name: args are not pushed again once the story renders
kills: the story bridge pushes the page's args to the story, and once more after the story next renders

mutations.name: the bridge takes args from any window and origin
kills: the story bridge takes args only from the console page's own window and origin

mutations.name: the bridge reports no boxes after a render
kills: the story bridge reports each element a pin can name after every render, with its testId, role and text
